data.title: Meta seeks to raise up to $25 billion in debt sale as AI spending jumps
data.description: Meta is aiming to raise between $20 billion and $25 billion in a bond sale as the company ramps up spending on infrastructure and AI models and services.
data.author: Seema Mody,Jonathan Vanian
